notes.title: the future of An Other Golf Game
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]H E L L O  [/b][/u][b]  [u]E V E R Y O N E   [/u] [/b][/h1][h3]
To keep everyone in the loop, here’s a quick update on the development.[/h3][p][/p][p]Apologies for not being quite as active the last couple months, I have been trying to enjoy some summer weather and also spending some time working on a different weird experimental [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495230/BOXBOYMAN/"]project[/url] in hopes to apply what I learn to An Other Golf Game. [/p][p][/p][p]Below you will find what I have been working on and what's to come. I’ve left out ongoing optimizations and bug fixes, since those are a constant part of development and will continue to receive regular attention.[/p][h2]
[u][b]Active Development (likely this year)[/b][/u][/h2][h3]
[b]Putting Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]The putting system is being completely rebuilt from the ground up allowing for a more natural ball rolling experience. This task has fortunately and unfortunately snowballed quite a bit and to ensure the putting experience is generally better I have been reworking the golf ball physics as well as cleaning up the meshes that make up each hole at the golf course.[/p][p][/p][p]This part of the update is taking up most of the development time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mini Golf Course[/b][/h3][p]There will be a mini golf course added to the world which should pair nicely with the putting overhaul that's in the works.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Cooking[/b][/h3][p]You'll likely want to cook those raw chickens once the cooking update is in.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Jobs[/b][/h3][p]Currently there are 9 "jobs" in the world, most of which can be found at the golf course. One of the 9 jobs is a 7 part job available from the rat man, and to kick that job off you'll need to find him on Monday. [/p][p]There are a few more golf course related jobs that are in the works, and a few jobs and tasks that will be added that can be found elsewhere.

For some of the new jobs, expect to use the tractor.[b]
[/b][/p][h3][b]Rain[/b][/h3][p]Occasional California downpours are on the way. Weather severity will affect course conditions and shot behavior.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][p]There's a bunch of other things: [/p][list][*][p]Downsizing NPC bones[/p][/*][*][p]Refining the drunk effect [/p][/*][*][p]Adding mushroom effects[/p][/*][*][p]Ball backspin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][u][b]Future Development (next year and beyond)[/b][/u][/h2][h3][/h3][h3][b]Tournament[/b][/h3][p]This is more of the long term goal for the game and one of the most challenging things to try to create in an open world golf sim in which you have to take your own score. I don't expect to have this complete by this year whatsoever. I am hopeful that next year after I tackle the near term goals listed above, I can start to deep dive into the tournament.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More NPCs[/b][/h3][p]Eventually there will be more NPCs roaming around the world, especially playing on the golf course. [/p][p]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who’s jumped into this niche, weird Early Access game, and my first game. Your feedback and bug reports are invaluable and truly make the experience better for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you have feedback, questions, concerns, want to share your experience, or ask me why there is no map at home, I'd love to hear it. Please use the steam forums or check out the discord.[/p][p][/p][p]thanks for your time
-waxycaps
[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: The putting system is being completely rebuilt from the ground up allowing for a more natural ball rolling experience.
There will be a mini golf course added to the world which should pair nicely with the putting overhaul that's in the works.
You'll likely want to cook those raw chickens once the cooking update is in.
There are a few more golf course related jobs that are in the works, and a few jobs and tasks that will be added that can be found elsewhere.
Occasional California downpours are on the way. Weather severity will affect course conditions and shot behavior.
Downsizing NPC bones
Refining the drunk effect
Adding mushroom effects
Ball backspin
Eventually there will be more NPCs roaming around the world, especially playing on the golf course.

notes.title: Performance Enhancing Updates
notes.content:
[b]General Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Main vehicle mirrors more performant and also generally brighter
[*] Some of the random world homes have been altered to be more performant (I plan to remodel most of the homes at some point)
[*] Altered grass for performance
[*] Removed a few background scripts for performance
[*] Cleaned up some road lines and roads for performance
[*] Hover text display optimized for performance
[*] Most Audio Sources get priority assigned to help with clipping audio (still learning and working on this as it's far from perfect)
[*] Slightly brighter at night
[*] Player Movement inputs can now bind to different keys
[*] Vehicle Steering inputs can now bind to different keys (wheel support still a work in progress)
[*] Findable clubs now all have custom names (example. The Butter Knife)
[*] More shaders/materials/textures will now be instanced by the GPU
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Driving Mode inputs and player state getting out of order when moving and entering driving mode
[*] Resolved issue with range ball audio causing some perf loss
[*] Resolved issue with ambient audio causes lag stuttering
[/list]

notes.title: Urgent Care Update - 50110P4
notes.content:
[h1]Die less with this update, but probably wish you just died in the first place. Enjoy![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yhDN5z0.png[/img]
[b]Build 50110P4[/b]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
- Fatal player impact thresholds increased
- Injuries, if not fatal, will send you to URGENT CARE
- Going to urgent care can be costly depending on the injury and treatment needed
- Golf Marshal will now fine you instead of taking your life, mostly
- The player can have negative cash
- Radio gets more music
- Adding a few things in the background to support the occasional rainy day (rainy days to be added in the future)
- Some more clubs to be found in the world
- NPC vehicles that get stuck will now reset eventually instead of just turning off
- NPC vehicles are more performant
- Ambient Audio Manager more performant
- Gas pump hose reworked, functionality stays the same

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Some minor UI updates
- Purchased Radios now also show station and power volume levels
- Radio speaker occasionally clipping audio fixed
- Removed "Radio On" text that displays briefly at game start
- Ice Bag no longer renders behind some materials
- Generally harder to die from physics weirdness, you absolutely still can, but various things have been put into place to try to protect against this
- Resolved bug that would cause ambient audio to stop playing/move to location that would be out of range of the player audio listener

[h2]Future[/h2]
The next update will be focused on performance and quality of life changes and tweaks. As always, to find out more specifics, I will update the discord as the feature list is formed and worked on.


thanks
- waxycaps

notes.title: December 19th Update - 19th Hole - 19% Sale
notes.content:
[b]hello hello hello[/b]

I've been quite busy the last month trying to get the "19th hole" into the game, and I think it's about time to share what I've got so far.

That said, I am excited to announce The Soggy Oak bar update is now available in the [b]test beta branch[/b]!

In celebration of the "19th hole" being added, it also being the 19th, and I guess the holidays, I am having a 19% off sale through New Years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047068/cf071f57d177f0cf760baba9d24077ce2586a8ba.gif[/img]

This big update is available right now, in the test branch. As a reminder, anyone can opt in to the test branch, feel free to reach out in the Discord if you need some help.

[b]Larger Updates[/b]

A new bar, The Soggy Oak, which has food, drinks, a TV with a variety of media, and a couple jobs available.

There is also a new Peninsula Park Area to explore.

Both the Bar, and the Park are still being heavily worked on and a lot more will be added to these areas with future updates.

Along with some of these larger content updates above, I have a bunch of other things that have been updated as well.

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus meter slows swing meter
[*] Targets on the driving range rearranged
[*] Bag club slots, bag pockets, golf cart scorecard holders get hover text to indicate location
[*] Tractor is less deadly
[*] Tree walls optimized
[*] Beer is stronger
[*] Towing Trailer
[*] Input settings for Attach Detach Trailer (must be in driving mode)
[*] Input settings for Quick Look (must be in golf mode)
[*] Camera Render Distance Settings
[*] Shadow Render Distance Settings
[*] Render Scale Settings
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rodents can only be hit once
[*] Jazz Intro, Cash Made achievements altered to ensure they trigger correctly
[*] Scorecard no longer causes golf cart death, you should still put the scorecard in the steering wheel
[/list]
... and many other smaller changes and fixes

Feel free to hop into the discord if you have any questions or issues to report.

Thanks and Happy Holidays

-troy

notes.title: Build 41113P
notes.content:
[b]You will need to start a new game[/b], unfortunately loading a previous saved game is not compatible with the most recent changes and you will likely experience weird broken stuff. This will likely be the case for some time during these early stages of the game, thanks for your understanding.

[b]Updates [/b]
[list]
[*] Moved speed threshold checks for enter/exit driving mode to player controller
[*] Enter/Exit Driving Mode Input changing from press to press and hold
[*] Player can now only sit in the enter driving mode area
[*] Trash spawn balancing
[*] Stage Carts job updated to use distance-based checks instead of inside-area checks
[*] Pump Job receives levers you need to interact with to turn them on
[*] More NPC driving changes (ongoing)
[*] Mushroom guy should buy everything during the active time window, and taking money should not end the transaction, door remains weird
[*] Urgent Care starts getting a few things in preparation for future updates
[*] Added 1 minute Saving cooldowns on new games, loaded games, and after sleeping
[*] Eating/Drinking gets brief cooldown
[*] Kick Out Job only happens once, guy changes locations after completing it
[*] Additional ball limit area added to help to limit NPC ball accumulation
[*] Lake is slightly lower
[*] Trailer area gets more ponds
[*] Slightly slower putting meter
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] MB Iron 8 had 7 iron as the hover text
[*] Boxes of balls inside the vehicle would no longer have collision with different objects after saving the game
[*] Missing Viper brand Woods/Driver text added
[*]Wedges now named, 52* Gap Wedge, 56* Sand Wedge, 60* Lob Wedge
[*] Beer High Score stat changed so it can't be spammed, can still eat the package
[*] Crawling deep to the back of the car will no longer kill you (death hinge)
[*] Toad missing sometimes fixed
[/list]
